items.content_html: 📋 Paste is a lightweight web application built with React ⚛️ that allows users to manage simple text 📝 or code 💻-based notes. ✨ Each paste includes a title 🏷️ and description 🗒️. 🚀 Users can quickly -- ➕ Add new pastes ✏️ Edit/Update them 📋 Copy their contents to the clipboard with a single click 🗑️ Delete them when no longer needed.
